rationale: This is a system chaincode (QSCC - Query System Chaincode) with Init/Invoke entrypoints. It performs read-only ledger queries (GetTransactionByID, GetBlockByNumber, GetBlockByHash, GetChainInfo, GetBlockByTxID) and returns results via shim.Success. There are no ledger writes (PutState/DelState), no time.Now() usage, no goroutines, no map iteration, and the package-level var `qscclogger` is only used for logging. All operations are deterministic read-only queries.
